data.description:
## Context / Problem

Discovered from majestic-depilatory-beetle. The advisory `sweep (windows)` job runs a maintained subset held green: tests known to fail on Windows are deselected through `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/posix-shell.args`. This bug owns that file: 143 tests in 23 modules, from the 5 scheduled runs at `b4e0d01b649` (2026-11-15/16).

Tests run `bash`, `/bin/sh` or `.sh` scripts. On the runner `bash` resolves to the WSL launcher with no distribution installed, which prints UTF-16 `Windows Subsystem for Linux has no installed distributions` and exits 1; `/bin/sh` is drive-relative and not found.

Largest modules: `tests/unit/test_gate_step_tree_skew.py` (81, runs workflow step bodies under `bash`), `tests/unit/workflow/test_reconcile_workflow_lint.py` (10), `tests/unit/test_check_deploy_manifest.py` (7), `tests/scripts/test_feature_branch_e2e_scenario4.py` (6), `tests/unit/test_session_shims.py` (6).

Example: `tests/scripts/test_feature_branch_inventory.py::test_rebased_content_equivalent_branch_reports_merged`: `AssertionError: returncode=1`.

## Approach

Per module decide: make the test portable (Python instead of shell), or skip on the missing capability (keyed on the capability, as bug subatomic-unwashed-macaw did with `os.access('/bin/sh', os.X_OK)`), never on `os.name`.

## Scope

The failing product or test code for this class, plus `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/posix-shell.args` (remove each fixed line; delete the file and its `@` reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml` once empty).

## Testing

POSIX: the touched tests still pass under `make verify`. Windows: a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the change (scheduled, or `gh workflow run test.yml --ref main`) passes with the removed lines no longer deselected.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The class's root cause is recorded on this ticket with the evidence that confirmed it.
- [ ] Every line removed from `posix-shell.args` names a test that passed (or skipped with a capability reason) in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the fix (run id recorded in a comment).
- [ ] `sweep (windows)` concludes `success` on that run.
data.title: Windows sweep: tests assume a POSIX shell (143 tests)
